fixed: A Caller's Companion library now brings each dance's formation across as it was recorded: counterclockwise Beckets stay counterclockwise, and four facing four, triplets, triple minors, longways and squares keep their shape instead of becoming duple improper.
Circle and scatter mixers from Caller's Companion are now marked as mixers, and your own description of a dance's starting position is kept as the formation's detail.
Alternates in Caller's Companion sets now come across as alternates instead of ordinary dances.

changed: CcDanceRecord carries the .USR formation columns separately (formationFamily, contraForm, direction, formationOther, subType), and mapCallersCompanionDance maps them together, setting mixer for CC mixer types.
